verdict.rationale: Avalara documents first-party natural-language surfaces: conversational queries for account and transaction analysis, AI-assisted explanation of tax calculations, the Avalara Avi Agent, and an official AvaTax MCP server that exposes tax calculation and transaction tools. These are described only in brief, and natural-language operation is evidenced mainly for analysis and explanation, not for the full range of product operations. Missing for 10: in-depth docs of Avi Agent command scope (e.g., creating transactions or nexus by natural language), documented natural-language write operations beyond MCP tool listings, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Analyze accounts faster with conversational queries. Explore transactions in detail to spot patterns or anomalies
